references.text: Issachar's sons are mentioned here for the first time: Tola, Puah, Jashub and Shimron. This is the original genealogy on which Numbers 26:23 is based.
The first census of the tribe of Issachar in the wilderness, which forms the basis for the genealogical record in chapter 26.
Tola's descendants and family register are described here in more detail, with Tola as a son of Issachar and ancestor of the Tolaites.
